answer: Bounty bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a key-signed work log in the nebula registry. The bond sits in the ocean pool, and any hunter proving a fake with a replayed log wins it: half burned, half paid to the hunter. Each fake needs its own 70-credit bond and fresh log; 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented logs fail: each is key-signed, and the tide audit replays it each epoch. An honest identity pays 70 once.
